name: B3 row-oriented training-free fusion

fixed_parameters.tie_breaker: 1e-6 x within-row rank of training disease popularity

selection_rule: Highest mean official Lin's AUC on eight random_simple development seeds disjoint from the 100 official seeds (seeds 1-8 after removing official seeds).
disclosure: weakly_correlated_split has no seed-dependent randomness in stanscofi 2.0.1, so its development run used the same single outer holdout as the official run (DP 0.7179, ALL-REV 0.7150, ALL 0.6938). These weak-split values were seen before freezing and were NOT used for primary selection. B3noREV (ALL-REV) is a post-hoc secondary variant and must be labelled as such.
